title: TRACE: Retrospective Streaming Generation of Physical Fields under Sparse Structured Sensing
abstract: arXiv:2608.26219v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reconstructing continuous physical fields from sparse measurements is central to scientific monitoring, inverse modeling, and digital-twin construction. Generative reconstruction has recently emerged as a promising paradigm for this task by learning data-driven physical priors that complete plausible full fields from limited observations. However, existing methods largely assume fixed, batch conditioning, whereas real sensing systems often produce structured streams: probes scan local regions, instruments observe moving fields of view, and communication constraints may leave entire frames missing. We propose TRACE, a retrospective streaming generative reconstruction framework for physical fields under structured sensing. translated_title: TRACE：稀疏结构化感知下物理场的回溯式流式生成
translated_abstract: 摘要：从稀疏测量中重建连续物理场是科学监测、逆建模和数字孪生构建的核心任务。近年来，生成式重建通过学习数据驱动的物理先验，从有限观测中补全合理的完整场，已成为该领域的一种有前景的范式。然而，现有方法大多假设固定的批量条件，而实际传感系统通常产生结构化流：探针扫描局部区域，仪器观测移动视场，通信限制可能导致整帧缺失。我们提出TRACE，一种用于结构化感知下物理场的回溯式流式生成重建框架。TRACE在学习的连续坐标潜在空间中进行近似贝叶斯推断，将稀疏非网格测量转换为生成式潜在证据，并通过状态空间时间先验融合，从而实现对动态物理场的实时重建。
tldr: TRACE提出了一种回溯式流式生成框架，通过在连续坐标潜在空间中融合稀疏非网格测量与状态空间时间先验，实现了对动态物理场的高效实时重建。
en_tdlr: TRACE proposes a retrospective streaming generative framework that integrates sparse off-grid measurements with a state-space temporal prior in a continuous-coordinate latent space, enabling efficient real-time reconstruction of dynamic physical fields.
